entities.summary: Aleksandr Mikhailovich Bezobrazov (Russian: Александр Михайлович Безобразов was a businessman and political adventurer from the Russian Empire who exerted a major influence on the foreign policies of the Russian Empire in the years prior to the Russo-Japanese War.
